description: A jobbing printer wedged into the back of the studio block, with a roller door instead of a window and the door up more often than not. Handbills dry on a line strung across the opening. The board outside lists what they do in order of how much of it they do: HANDBILLS, RUNNING ORDERS, SETLISTS, MENUS, WREATH CARDS, WRITS. The last one is not a joke and is priced accordingly.
name: Just My Type
